$comment: Pi-side settings for the mcp-combiner extension's client half. Copy to $PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/extensions/mcp-combiner.json (default ~/.config/pi/agent/extensions/). Connection URL and per-project server exposure live in the shared MCP config ladder (.pi/mcp.json / ~/.config/mcp/mcp.json) instead — see README. Env vars (PI_MCP_COMBINER_*) win over this file. mode: 'legacy' (default) = the hand-rolled SDK client with the mcp router + script tool + directTools promotion; 'native' = the pi-mcp transport (peer dep, requires pi >= 1.0) with per-tool pi-1.0 registration (exposure/namespace/annotations) + the mcp router; no mcpScript. adapter gates the client half in legacy mode: true = we are the MCP tool, false = pi-mcp-adapter owns MCP (process + instructions only), 'auto' (default) = false when pi-mcp-adapter is installed.
